channel.title: North Wales Chronicle - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from North Wales Chronicle (northwaleschronicle.co.uk)

item.title: Pods, yurt and caravan plan refused over ‘harm’ to Anglesey beauty spot
item.description: A glamping project touted as low‑impact has been turned down by Anglesey Council, which said it would harm the AONB and lacked evidence on wildlife and flood safety.

item.title: You can win £500,000 helping Walkers find its next big crisp flavour
item.description: Walkers is on the hunt for its next big flavour – with the creator in with the chance of winning a prize of up to £500k.

item.title: Police Commissioner meets farmers, pledges to reduce rural crime
item.description: The Police and Crime Commissioner has reaffirmed his commitment to tackling rural crime after meeting with farmers.

item.title: Bringing the mountains to the big screen with short film collections
item.description: A film festival is bringing stories of adventure to the big screen.

item.title: Acclaimed North Wales restaurant named one of the UK’s Top 100
item.description: Acclaimed restaurant The Jackdaw has been named one of the UK’s Top 100 Restaurants for 2026, with chef Nick Rudge’s modern Welsh cooking earning national praise and cementing the town’s growing reputation as a culinary destination.

item.title: Bangor man who had 'devastating' impact jailed for multiple drug offences
item.description: A man from Bangor has been jailed for multiple drug offences.

item.title: ‘999? I’ve got a wobbly tooth!’ – Non-emergency calls to Welsh Ambulance revealed
item.description: The Welsh Ambulance Service has revealed more about some of the strangest non-emergency calls they received throughout 2025.

item.title: Anglesey leaders back 5.1% tax rise - but say it remains lowest in North Wales
item.description: Anglesey’s Executive has backed an initial 5.1% council tax rise as part of its draft £207m budget for 2026/27, with leaders warning the final figure could still shift before Full Council signs it off in March.

item.title: Empty homes to face 300% council tax premium in Anglesey
item.description: Properties that lie empty for more than a decade will be slapped with a 300% council tax premium with properties lying empty for less than five years facing a 100% hike.

item.title: Anglesey drug dealer caught with significant amount of cocaine and cash jailed
item.description: Jones previously admitted to possession with intent to supply Class A drugs, possession of criminal property and possession of an offensive weapon.
